description: This PHP class defines the SoapError class used for handling SOAP error information within the SuiteCRM project. It manages error details like name, number, and description, and provides methods to set errors based on predefined definitions, retrieve error details, and format errors as arrays.

classes.name: SoapError
classes.description: Represents and manages SOAP error information, including setting error details and retrieving error data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SoapError instance and sets a default error using set_error('no_error').

methods.name: set_error
methods.description: Sets the error details based on the provided error name, referencing external error definitions.

methods.name: get_soap_array
methods.description: Returns the error details as an associative array suitable for SOAP responses.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the error.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the error.
